title: Things To Do in Boone NC This Thanksgiving Weekend
excerpt: Thanksgiving weekend in Boone, NC is one of the most beautiful and festive times of year in the High Country. From fall foliage and mountain hikes to holiday shopping on King Street and warm local dining, there is no better time to experience why so many people are choosing to call this region home.
